input.question: Where is the search_code tool defined?

issueContexts.title: Wire search_code into chat route handler

cannedResponse.answer: The search_code tool is defined in packages/web/src/server/application/agents/tools/repo/searchCode.ts. It is implemented as a server-only AI SDK tool with Zod-typed input and output schemas; its boundary schemas are exported from the core package for the chat route handler.
